summary: Focused frontend run (PDF and backend skipped). All requested flows PASSED: book has 198 pages, indicator shows '/ 197', the front cover is an IMG (naturalWidth 880), and back-cover is the last page. TOC lists Bab 1-20 with real titles; toc-link-bab-8 lands on spread 79-80 with chapter-opener-8 on page 80, matching the TOC number 80; toc-link-kesimpulan lands on page 194. Chapter text pages contain real manuscript text and 20 .blk-img images. Worksheet 1: typing in ws-p1-bigwhy and ws-p1-risk does not flip the page (ArrowRight in the textarea doesn't either), and both values persist after reload. ws-p2-emosi-0 toggles is-on. Quiz Cepat part 1: clicking options did not flip the page; submitting showed score 2/3, which persists after reload. Highlight mode: bab-1:2 gets blk-hl without a page flip, the Stabilo tab lists the highlight, clicking it jumps to 23-24, it persists after reload, and clicking again removes it. Bookmark toggle, Penanda list and bookmark-remove all work. Sound toggle writes ht-sound 1->0->1. Mobile 390x844: toolbar scrollWidth equals clientWidth (390), single page view, and highlighting works on mobile.

ui_bugs.issue: On the Kesimpulan spread (193-194) the toolbar subtitle shows 'Lembar Praktik Bagian V' because current = left page (a blank verso belonging to the previous section). Minor.

issues: Many chapter openers sit on the right page with a fully blank left verso (e.g. 79 before Bab 8, 193 before Kesimpulan). This is normal book convention but adds many empty screens. On mobile it shows as a blank single page.
Body text is scaled down to about 9-10px effective size, which is hard to read on mobile; consider a larger mobile scale or reflow.
In spread mode a bookmark always records the left page (e.g. 23 for spread 23-24). Acceptable, but the label could show the spread.

action_items: Optional: derive the toolbar section title from the right page when the left page is blank (Kesimpulan spread)
Optional: improve mobile text legibility; hide blank versos in portrait mode
critical_code_review_comments: Reader.jsx: idPage/hlItems are recomputed on every render over all 198 pages; wrap in useMemo
Reader.jsx: ht-page from localStorage is not validated for NaN (carried over from iteration 1)
